crag.definition: n. a steep rugged rock or cliff
crag.translation:
n. 峭壁, 危岩
[建] 岩石碎块

cragged.translation:
a. 多岩的, 多峭壁的, 崎岖的
[建] 碎片的, 角蛮状的

craggedness.translation: n. 多岩状, 峻峭, 崎岖

craggier.definition:
comparative of craggy
s having hills and crags
craggier.translation: (craggy 的比较级) a. 多岩的, 崎岖的, 峻峭的, 多峭壁的

craggily.translation: adv. craggy（多癴崖的, 多峭壁的）的变形

cragginess.definition: n. The state of being craggy.
cragginess.translation: n. 多岩状, 峻峭, 崎岖

cragging.definition:
-ing form of crag
n. a steep rugged rock or cliff
cragging.translation:
(crag 的现在分词) n. 峭壁, 危岩
[建] 岩石碎块

craggs.translation: (Cragg 的复数) n. (Cragg)人名；(英)克拉格

craggy.translation: a. 多岩的, 崎岖的, 峻峭的, 多峭壁的

crags.definition: n. a steep rugged rock or cliff
crags.translation: n. 悬崖, 峭壁( crag的复数形式 )

cragsman.definition: n a climber of vertical rock faces
cragsman.translation: n. 善于攀登危岩峭壁者, 爬岩崖能手

cragsmen.translation: n. 爬岩名手；善于攀登危岩和峭壁者
